rule.c: largest statistic of a feasible trajectory among the 2,625 constant plans (tax 0..20 x five funding levels of road, fire, police; no macro) on the primary seed and the 20 best by J also on the eight secondary seeds; if none feasible, the largest statistic regardless (c_feasible false)
rule.J: statistic if feasible, else -1e9 + slack of the violated clause (dc.frontier.J)
rule.e: largest nine-seed mean statistic among finalists feasible on all nine seeds; finalists = the 50 best by J on the primary seed from each source: a pools, b pools with budget columns overwritten by the three best constant settings, c closed-loop scripted builders under the two best settings (500 each; H = 24 only), d cross-entropy search on the engine (10 generations of 1000, behaviour-pool init and builder-pool init, tax and funding centred on the best constant setting)
rule.well_posed: e - c >= 4 x seed_sd (sd of the frontier plan's statistic over the nine seeds, ddof 1)
rule.best constant settings: constant plans ranked by J on the primary seed; ties broken by the feasibility slack (larger first), then by grid order
rule.finalist ties: the 50 best by J of a source, ties broken by the feasibility slack, then by position
rule.c_mean9 (diagnostic, not the rule): largest nine-seed mean statistic among the 20 constant plans replayed on nine seeds that are feasible on all nine
rule.closed-loop seeds: source c's builders play under a closed-loop seed of their own (as the builder pool does) with the task's forced events applied, then are replayed on the primary seed
rule.treasury: tax collected at the last yearly budget up to H (tax_fund at H) >= theta, funds never negative, and the tax rate never above the rate at the start
rule.stat_sd: spread of the statistic under the behaviour mix, as in tasks_H24.json; recomputed for treasury, whose statistic changed
rule.base_rate_fit / base_rate_val / in_band: the v1 definitions (behaviour-mix calibration trajectories, first 600 / last 400 plans, band 0.2..0.5) at the v2 theta; the band is not part of the v2 rule
rule.base_rates: pass shares at theta (primary seed for pools, b, c, constants; cross-entropy selected plan: primary verdict and share of the eight secondary seeds)

seeds.secondary: seed_for('task-secondary', start_id, task, H, k), k = 0..7
seeds.cem: seed_for('tv2-cem', start_id, variant, H, init, B)
seeds.closed_loop: seed_for('tv2-c-policy' | 'tv2-c-gen', start_id, H, forced_key, setting, j)

oracle.value: m32 = 16th largest of the 32 per-seed feasible statistics (minus infinity where infeasible); passes at theta exactly when >= 16 of 32 seeds pass (an exact 16 passes)
oracle.c32: largest m32 among the 20 best constant plans (those replayed on the nine seeds)
oracle.e32: m32 of the nine-seed rule's frontier plan (not re-selected on the oracle seeds)
oracle.theta: theta = theta32(0.5) = c32 + 0.5 (e32 - c32); theta32_l25, theta32_l75 likewise; the nine-seed rule's fields keep their names (c, e, seed_sd, well_posed, theta_l25, theta_l50, theta_l75)
oracle.well_posed32: e32 - c32 >= 6 x 1.2533 x seed_sd32 / sqrt(32), or e32 - c32 > 0 where seed_sd32 = 0
oracle.base_rate_fit / base_rate_val / in_band: v1 definitions (calibration trajectories, single replays) at theta32(0.5)
oracle.base_rates32: pass shares under the majority rule at theta32(0.5) (100-plan seeded subsets of each source; constants; cross-entropy selected plans)
oracle.base_rates_seed0: the same plans on oracle seed 0 alone
